rule: a shell placeholder the build cannot substitute
expect: a shell the build cannot substitute
why: THE SHELL CHECK, WHICH READS EVERY `apps/*\/src/app.html` IN THE WORKSPACE. It is in `bundle` because that gate already reads a built shell, and until now it read only the built one, only for `apps/web`, and only when there was a build. The source form needs neither, and it reaches `apps/site`, which nothing in this suite had ever read a line of. The fixture spells the body placeholder twice and the head placeholder once, so a count of one is what proves the gate reports the placeholder that is wrong rather than every placeholder it finds.
